title: Power with let rec
starter:
let rec power base exp =
  if exp = 0 then 1 else base
hints: Write it as a sentence first: base to the power exp is base times (base to the power exp - 1).
The base case is already right: anything to the power 0 is 1. The other branch has to call `power` again with a smaller `exp`.

answer.code:
let rec power base exp =
  if exp = 0 then 1 else base * power base (exp - 1)
answer.explain: `power base exp` is `base * power base (exp - 1)`, and the recursion stops at `exp = 0`, which gives 1. Each call makes `exp` one smaller, so it always reaches the base case.
